narrative: On the almanack. The almanac open on the desk, one short line in the margin of the second of February. Two groats and a twist of comfits sit beside the inkhorn. No letter is begun.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the line and did not begin the letter.

entities.context: Shown on almanac in Twins' day
